title: About
text:
This website provides an interactive portal for exploring collegiate women’s wrestling data across the National Association of Intercollegiate Athletics (NAIA).



300+


Wrestlers Tracked




39


Collegiate Programs




10


Weight Classes






Roster Accessibility: Provide accessible, filterable team rosters for all NAIA institutions with women’s wrestling programs.
National Tournament Results: Track individual national tournament placements, points scored, and win-loss match records from official NAIA Championship events.
Data Transparency: Offer clean, public CSV datasets for sports data science research and analysis.





Tournament Data: Sourced from official public event tournament results hosted on Trackwrestling.
Institutional Directory: Compiled from NAIA varsity athletics directories, tracking institution names, locations, and conferences.
Built with: Quarto, R, and the Tidyverse.
